contributions.text: Added detection rules for Anthropic OAuth access and refresh tokens (from Claude subscription logins), which no existing rule matched
Removed the stopword list from the generic API key rule, which dropped random keys that happened to contain a common word; on 200 random keys with an embedded word, detections rose from 33 to 126

description: The code coverage tool for Python.

contributions.text: Fixed a crash on Python 3.14 with the pytrace core and branch coverage, where the return after an except* handler recorded a None line and broke saving and reporting

description: A Flake8 plugin for finding likely bugs and design problems in Python programs.

contributions.text: Fixed B040 false positives when a caught exception with an added note is logged through logger.exception(), exc_info=True or the traceback helpers
Follow-up from review: fut.exception() and exc_info=False are no longer treated as handling the exception

description: A mutation testing system for Python.

contributions.text: Re-run cached mutants when test files are edited, added or deleted, by storing a hash of each test file, so weakening a test no longer leaves its mutants reported as killed
Remove deleted test files from the mutants/ copy so stale tests stop killing mutants

description: The Python source code representation behind pylint.

contributions.text: Stopped call-site inference from unpacking an empty list literal that is later filled by append or extend, which caused no-value-for-parameter false positives in pylint

description: A modern, C++-native test framework for unit tests, TDD and BDD.

contributions.text: Fixed test discovery under Emscripten by reading the test listing from stdout, so builds and ctest runs no longer fail

description: The largest hub of ready-to-use datasets for AI models, with efficient data manipulation tools.

contributions.text: Fixed to_json silently writing wrong values for fixed-shape Array2D to Array5D columns

description: An open-source Python library for AI browser agents.

contributions.text: Priced OpenRouter requests from the cost OpenRouter reports, instead of leaving it empty for unlisted models, and added a per-request cost breakdown

description: Deep learning tools for brain medical images.

contributions.text: Made the brain extractor work with TensorFlow 2.x
